title: Hearty Flaky Syrian Orange Flatbread
description: This citrusy flatbread is a traditional Syrian dish featuring muscovado sugar and a flaky texture, perfect for a snack or light meal. It is low in sodium and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, muscovado sugar, orange zest, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the orange juice, olive oil, and yeast.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Preheat the broiler and punch down the dough.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on a baking sheet.
Broil the flatbreads for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
